summary: Bench sheets for the Nimbravelle NM-12 precipitation-on-dilution follow-up (DL_2020_0050). The vehicle ladder compares eight vehicles at 10 mg/mL, the dilution sheet records the precipitation seen when the cosolvent-rich vehicle was diluted, and the handling notes explain why Nimbravelle took the dispersed dosing approach.

rows.v: Dilution challenge, cosolvent-rich vehicle and dispersed alternative

rows: Each vehicle loaded at dosing strength, then diluted into simulated gastric medium at the ratios below. Read by eye and by light microscopy at 0.5 h, 2 h and 24 h.
Fails. Drug falls out as needles
Fails at the higher ratio too
Reference standard run before each dilution series. Passed.

sheets.name: Handling notes
rows: Interim: the cosolvent-rich vehicle has high equilibrium solubility, but it does not survive dilution. Dispersed options are the way forward for the dosing solution.
Pharmacy handling check with the client's clinical supplies team. Dispersed vehicle needs a shake step before each dose. Written into the dosing instructions.
Final. Client selected the dispersed approach. Tradeoff accepted: a shake step on every dose in exchange for no precipitation on dilution.
